metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description: Detects execution of fsutil.exe with arguments that attempt to change symbolic link evaluation behavior via the behavior set SymlinkEvaluation command. This activity may indicate an attempt to enable insecure Remote-to-Local (R2L) or Remote-to-Remote (R2R) symlink access, which is disabled by default in Windows due to security risks.
properties.query:
// Detects execution of fsutil.exe with arguments that attempt to change symbolic link evaluation behavior via the behavior set SymlinkEvaluation command. This activity may indicate an attempt to enable insecure Remote-to-Local (R2L) or Remote-to-Remote (R2R) symlink access, which is disabled by default in Windows due to security risks. 
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4688,1)
| where Process  has "fsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_all ("behavior", "set", "SymlinkEvaluation")
| extend
    ComputerName = tostring(column_ifexists("Computer", "")),
    Account = tostring(
        coalesce(
            column_ifexists("SubjectUserName", ""),
            column_ifexists("Account", "")
        )
    ),
    CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("ServiceFileName", ""))
